limitations: 3N is only a proposed finite motor force setting, not a holding guarantee.
Both rest/initial and one saved ungrasped settled shape are frozen geometry cases; the future grasp probe has its own fresh soft state.
Robot hand collision meshes are individually convexified. A blocked convex component can overestimate its nonconvex native surface; no surface-body collision law is changed.
The 90mm straight Cartesian hand sweep is a continuous frozen solid envelope; robot IK is checked only at declared poses, not the entire arm trajectory.
Pad ray sections are geometric closure opportunities, not actual contact area, force closure or stability evidence.
The whole bag/arm trajectory and future dynamic grasp must be independently verified before any full task trial.
